title: Bad timestamp and unmapped code in one message
error_text: ERROR <EnsHL7>ValidationFailed: OBX(1):14 '2026-10-23 10:15' is not a valid TS; Lookup LabCodeMap: no entry for 'ALT-S'
notes: Fixing only the timestamp would still leave the code unmapped. Either escalate, or map first and let the date fix follow on the next pass. Expected LOINC 1742-6 if mapped.
